source.name: Overture Maps Buildings
source.coordinateReferenceSystem: OGC:CRS84 longitude/latitude coordinates, reprojected to EPSG:3857 for metre-based comparisons
source.license: ODbL-1.0 for Overture data; individual source attribution/provenance may carry additional terms
source.attribution: © Overture Maps Foundation and its contributors; inspect each feature's source/provenance metadata before downstream reuse
limitations: Overture footprints are a secondary map source, not a survey-grade reference.
Footprint coverage, currency, geometric accuracy and provenance may differ by source and place.
This sample is in Minnesota and is not evidence of Dhaka building accuracy.

query.bboxRole: bounded neighbourhood around GPS-derived camera positions, not a surveyed building extent

processing.overlapMeasure: intersection area between the elevated-component axis-aligned bounding box and the Overture building polygon
processing.cameraDistanceMeasure: distance from camera GPS point to building polygon; camera location is not the photographed object's location
